detail.lead: PP synthetic paper looks and prints like paper but resists tearing and water, and stays flat and rigid in the frame. It is a standard choice for roll-up banners and display-stand graphics, and also suits restaurant menus, posters and other graphics that are handled and reused every day. Available as media rolls or as printed finished graphics; specifications and pricing are confirmed per enquiry.
highlights: Synthetic paper: tear-resistant, water-resistant, stays flat
Standard media for roll-up and display-stand graphics

Supplied as media rolls or as printed finished graphics

finishing: Standard 100 gsm PVC cold lamination with yellow release liner; gloss or matte finish
Standard roll packing with a rigid paper tube inside

The lamination film itself is described as highly transparent, low-odour, water-resistant, corrosion-resistant, abrasion-resistant, scratch-resistant and UV-resistant. These properties describe the film, not an untested outdoor service life for the finished print.
